_comment: Demo consumers per workspace. These stand in for people who signed up in the CUSTOMER's own product — Loopride's app, Northwind's checkout — not people an admin typed into WorkVibe. `provision.mjs users` upserts them and, for each one it had to create, emits SUBSCRIBER_ONBOARDED so the onboarding workflow fires exactly once, the way a real signup would. Re-running never re-sends. The first entry in each list is the preview recipient every template's mock_data points at; keep it. All addresses are @example.com (IANA-reserved, cannot receive mail).
